caption: Do you need a gaming PC for sim racing? No. With the TV you have, a PS5 setup is $439 and an Xbox one $608. A PC rig starts at $1,258 with a VR headset you own, and the PC isn't in it. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #ps5
title: Do you need a gaming PC for sim racing? No: $439 on a PS5
